requirement.text: When prompted by passengers, the system should be able to provide information requested, eg customer asking for summary on a trip should be able to get one from the system.

initial_eus.title: Passenger Information Requests
initial_eus.description: As a passenger, I want the system to provide the information I request when I prompt it, so that I can obtain what I need about my trip, such as a trip summary.
work_items: The system shall provide the requested information when prompted by a passenger.
When a passenger requests a summary of a trip, the system shall provide one.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure passengers can obtain the information they request from the system on demand, supporting transparency and passenger agency over information about their trip.

obligations.text: When prompted by a passenger, the system shall provide the information the passenger requested.
obligations.source_span: When prompted by passengers, the system should be able to provide information requested

obligations.text: A passenger who requests a summary of a trip shall be able to obtain one from the system.
obligations.source_span: eg customer asking for summary on a trip should be able to get one from the system

constraints: Applies when the system is prompted by a passenger (request-driven, not proactive provision).
The information provided must correspond to what the passenger requested.
A trip summary is an explicitly stated example of information that must be obtainable.
ambiguities: The scope of 'information requested' is unspecified; it is unclear whether any request must be satisfiable or only certain categories of information.
The content and level of detail of a 'trip summary' are not defined.
'Passengers' and 'customer' are used interchangeably; it is unclear whether they denote the same stakeholder.
The form of prompting (e.g., spoken, textual, in-app) and the form of the response are not specified.
'Should be able to' leaves unclear whether this is a capability the system must have or a guarantee that every request is fulfilled.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific interaction modality (e.g., voice assistant, chat interface).
Do not assume timing or response-time requirements.
Do not assume a defined list of trip summary contents.
Do not assume the system must answer every conceivable request, including those outside its information domain.
Do not assume access controls, privacy handling, or authentication requirements beyond what the source states.
Do not assume a legal or policy basis for the obligation.
possible_operational_aspects: Provision of information is conditional on a passenger prompt or request.
The response must match the specific information requested.
A trip summary is a representative case that must be supported.

work_items.explanation: Expresses the general obligation that the system provide the information a passenger requested when prompted by the passenger, preserving the request-driven condition and the correspondence between request and response.
Expresses the explicit trip-summary example: a passenger who requests a summary of a trip shall be able to obtain one from the system.
